g.text: ACCOMMODATION VALIDATION: every counted slot checked over its complete footprint against the canonical side line of its deck

A slot is valid only if, over its complete footprint (sampled every 0.05 m), corridorHalfWidth + corridorBulkhead + interiorDepth + balconyDepth (balcony decks; cabinVariants override it for the listed cabins only) + sideStructureAllowance ≤ the local side line of its level (decks 5–7: superstructure side; deck 4: hull side − hullLining).
